summary: This directory manages configuration providers and application layers for dependency injection. It acts as a central hub for defining environment-specific settings and service layers, ensuring consistent system initialization and operational context for the application.
responsibilities: Define service layers for dependency injection
Provide consistent configuration access across different execution environments
relationships: Configuration providers supply the necessary settings for the service layers to initialize properly.
The application layers aggregate specific service providers to create a unified context for dependency injection.
Platform-specific service layers rely on environment configurations to establish the correct runtime behavior.
designDecisions: Use of the Layer pattern for dependency injection to support modular environment configuration.
Separation between production and test providers to ensure consistent testability.
Centralized management of application infrastructure through composition of service layers.
